ITEM 1 | Fresh spinach leaves, dark green, flat and glossy with slightly crinkled edges, scattered across the bottom and sides of a white oval bowl, covering roughly 55% of the visible bowl area, leaves about 6-10 cm long, piled to about 2-3 cm high in places | 90
ITEM 2 | Cucumber slices, pale green skin with lighter flesh, cut into half-moons and wedges about 1-2 cm thick and 3-4 cm across, moist surface, scattered among the spinach on the left and lower part of the bowl, covering roughly 12% of the bowl | 60
ITEM 3 | Whole kalamata-style olives, dark purple-brown to nearly black, smooth glossy skin, oval about 2-2.5 cm long and 1-1.5 cm wide, slightly wrinkled, some with a pale sheen, scattered across the center of the bowl, covering roughly 12% of the bowl and about 1.5 cm high in clusters | 55
ITEM 4 | Black olive, a single dark glossy oval piece near the right edge of the bowl, about 2 cm long, smooth skin | 4
